{{- /* Admonition. Icon and title share the top row; the body starts on its own line underneath, flush with the icon, so the text gets the same padding on both sides. A full 1px border in the alert's colour replaces the old thick left bar, which pushed the content 4px further from the left edge than the right. */ -}} {{- $color := .Get "color" | default "info" -}} {{- /* Every alert gets a title row. Without one the icon sat alone above the body, which read as a different component from the titled alerts. */ -}} {{- $defaultTitle := "Note" -}} {{- if eq $color "warning" }}{{ $defaultTitle = "Warning" }}{{ else if eq $color "danger" }}{{ $defaultTitle = "Danger" }}{{ end -}} {{- $title := .Get "title" | default $defaultTitle -}} {{- /* Colours are the brand.json tokens (gd-warning, gd-danger; light and dark), as on the API pills. */ -}} {{- $borderClass := "border-gd-border" -}} {{- $iconSvg := "" -}} {{- if eq $color "warning" -}} {{- $borderClass = "border-gd-warning/60" -}} {{- $iconSvg = `` -}} {{- else if eq $color "danger" -}} {{- $borderClass = "border-gd-danger/60" -}} {{- $iconSvg = `` -}} {{- else -}} {{- $iconSvg = `` -}} {{- end -}}
{{- /* The title is a div, not a p: inside .prose a p picks up the typography margins, and a my-0 utility only ties them on specificity. */}}
{{ $iconSvg | safeHTML }}
{{ $title }}
{{- /* text-sm alone gives a 20px line height, cramped for multi-line notes and bullet lists; leading-relaxed brings it close to the surrounding prose. */}}
{{ .Inner | markdownify }}
